A '''S.t.a.s.h blueprint''' is an item that can be purchased from [[Watson]] for {{NoCoins|500}} coins. It is used to make a [[S.t.a.s.h chart]] in a [[player-owned house]] [[study]].

==Trivia==
* The name of this item does not have a correctly capitalised acronym; this is because all items in ''Old School RuneScape'' originally used ''ucfirst'' capitalisation, wherein the first letter of a string is capitalised, but the rest is not.{{CiteReddit|author=Mod Sarnie|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/2007scape/comments/mlyqkq/comment/gto9lzq/?context=3|title=Collection Log Improvements and The Last of Poll 74 - Game Update (07/04/21)|date=07 April 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106497|archivedate=13 April 2021|quote=This is something that happens engine side unfortunately, it will only capitalise the first letter of an object and the rest of the letters will become lower case.}}
